Package com.bupt.ta.persistence

Class ServiceFactory

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.persistence.ServiceFactory
public final class ServiceFactory extends Object
Wires services from JSON data files under WEB-INF/data and CV storage directory.

Created once at startup by AppInitListener and stored in the servlet context under SERVLET_CONTEXT_KEY. Servlets resolve domain services (auth, jobs, applications, AI-related workload helpers) from this factory rather than constructing FileStore directly.

Thread-safe for read-only service access after initialization; underlying JSON files are not locked for concurrent writes.
